headline: Iran War Escalates Global Energy Crisis, Threatening Broad Supply Chain Disruption and Inflation.
summary: The ongoing Iran war is generating a second wave of severe energy shocks, projected to cause global oil supply to plunge below demand and significantly drive up inflation and operational costs. This persistent conflict directly impacts global supply chain logistics and the economic viability of all industries, including the critical tech and manufacturing sectors, through increased energy prices and widespread cost pressures.
